package.name: rviz_camera_control
package.description: RViz2 panel and view controller plugin providing complete external (ROS 2 topic driven) control of the RViz render camera -- position, orientation, field of view and clip planes -- plus continuous camera state telemetry. Intended as the visualization layer of an autonomous UAV operator interface: the camera can be driven from vehicle pose, a chase/follow controller, a scripted flythrough, or any other external source, without touching RViz's own source tree.
